# FAQ-009 Engineering FAQ #9
Revision: Rev A

Q1: What is the recommended spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03)?
A1: The spindle warm-up time is 27 minutes. Allow the spindle to reach steady state before commencing precision turning operations. See ECN-2026-004 for the related change note.

Q2: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02)?
A2: The coil cooling water flow minimum is 55 L/min. Verify flow at the heater inlet during startup and monitor for sustained flow below this threshold. Refer to SOP-P2-L1-03 for procedures on flow verification and alarm responses.

Q3: Which lubricant part number is used for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01)?
A3: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-961 for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Apply per lubrication schedule and contamination control processes. See SOP-P3-L3-02 for handling and storage instructions.

Q4: Which lubricant part number is used for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01)?
A4: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-709 for EQ-P3-L3-SB01. Confirm compatibility with media and equipment surfaces before application. See SOP-P3-L3-02 for application method and PPE requirements.

Q5: Which lubricant part number is used for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02)?
A5: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-278 for EQ-P3-L1-SB02. Record lubricant usage in the equipment log and follow contamination control. See SOP-P2-L1-03 and SOP-P3-L3-02 for maintenance and storage cross-references.

Related documents: ECN-2026-004, SOP-P2-L1-03, SOP-P3-L3-02

Document control note: This FAQ clarifies single-point operational values and part references. For procedural detail follow the cited SOPs and ECN.
